sections.heading: What is trending: “pertandingan liga 1”
paragraphs: “pertandingan liga 1” appeared on Google Trends' Trending Now list for ID (snapshot taken 2026-10-26T13:02:16+00:00 UTC). Google reports at least 100,000 searches for this term — that figure is a lower bound published in the official Trends feed, not an exact count.

sections.heading: What's behind the spike — the coverage
paragraphs: The Trends feed associates this search spike with 3 news stories from ANTARA Foto, Kompas.com, Radar Solo. The headlines, exactly as published:
list: “Garudayaksa FC was defeated by Persib Bandung” — ANTARA Foto
“Hasil Garudayaksa FC vs Persib 1-2, Igor Tolic Ungkap Kunci Kemenangan” — Kompas.com
“Kartu Merah Menit ke-85, Gol Adam Alis Menit ke-90+1: Persib Bandung Menang Dramatis” — Radar Solo

sections.heading: Timeline
paragraphs: The trend entry was published to the Google Trends feed at Mon, 26 Oct 2026 05:40:00 -0700. Our snapshot was taken at 2026-10-26T13:02:16+00:00 UTC and this briefing was assembled at 2026-10-26T13:03:05+00:00 UTC.

sections.heading: How to read these numbers
paragraphs: Google Trends reports approximate search volume as a lower bound (for example “20K+”). Actual volume can be significantly higher. Trending status reflects acceleration in searches, not the absolute size of a topic. For the full story behind the spike, read the cited coverage below — this briefing intentionally adds no speculation beyond the sourced facts.
